title: Answer: will is a real systemic cause, agency is centered on the self-model

statements.text: Consciousness is placed at the heart of agency. Belief updates that entail intentions make will power a systemic cause, and the free will worth wanting survives Libet-style findings, with agency spread over conscious and unconscious parts like a conductor and an orchestra.

sources.quote: If these beliefs entail intentions for acting and the phenomenology of willing, then will power may be a systemic cause and source of force in every meaningful sense of the words
we have shown that intentions—as conjoined beliefs and desires—can function causally in their ability to act as coherently stable predictions
